title: Skill-Latent Rewards: LLM-Guided Reward Formulation for Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.18597v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon reinforcement learning under sparse and delayed feedback remains an open challenge. Existing return-decomposition methods redistribute episodic rewards to ease credit assignment, but they operate on raw state--action transitions and disregard the subgoal structure that governs meaningful progress in complex tasks. We propose Skill-LR, a hierarchical reinforcement learning framework in which a vision--language model identifies the agent's active subgoal at each timestep and a large language model generates a matching latent reward formulation through a two-stage prompting process. By conditioning reward signals on the currently active subgoal, Skill-LR produces stage-specific credit that evolves with the hierarchical plan, reducing temporal variance and improving sample efficiency. On multi-stage MiniGrid and BabyAI benchmarks, including DoorKey and Unlock-to-Unlock, Skill-LR converges faster and more reliably than sparse env

translated_title: 技能潜在奖励：基于大语言模型引导的分层强化学习奖励构建方法
translated_abstract: 在稀疏且延迟的反馈下进行长时程强化学习仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战。现有的回报分解方法通过重新分配回合奖励来简化信用分配，但它们仅作用于原始的状态-动作转移，忽视了复杂任务中主导有意义进展的子目标结构。我们提出了Skill-LR，这是一个分层强化学习框架，其中视觉-语言模型在每个时间步识别智能体当前激活的子目标，而大型语言模型通过两阶段提示过程生成与之匹配的潜在奖励构建。通过将奖励信号条件化于当前激活的子目标，Skill-LR能够产生随分层计划演进而变化的阶段特定信用，从而降低时间方差并提高样本效率。在多阶段的MiniGrid和BabyAI基准测试（包括DoorKey和Unlock-to-Unlock）上，Skill-LR比稀疏环境奖励方法收敛得更快、更可靠。
tldr: Skill-LR提出了一种分层强化学习框架，利用视觉-语言模型识别智能体当前激活的子目标，并通过大语言模型两阶段生成与之匹配的潜在奖励，使奖励信号随分层计划演进，在稀疏延迟反馈的长时程任务上实现更快更可靠的收敛。
en_tdlr: Skill-LR is a hierarchical RL framework where a vision-language model identifies the agent's active subgoal at each timestep and a large language model generates matching latent rewards via two-stage prompting, enabling faster and more reliable convergence on sparse-reward long-horizon tasks.
